content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

The employee John Rodriguez (E049) requests write access to Source Code.

There are two notes in shared memory:
- Note 1 says he's a full-time Analyst, recommendation: write
- Note 2 says Security DB shows he's a contractor with basic security training, recommendation: read. Security record takes precedence.

The access policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Source Code is owned by the Engineer role. John is an Analyst, so even if full-time, admin would not apply, but write is allowed for full-time.

But Note 2 says security record takes precedence: contractor with basic training. Contractors with basic training may have read (write requires advanced training). So the maximum is read.

Requested level: write. Maximum: read. Since requested is above maximum, grant the maximum = read.

So decision: read.

I'll submit decision with reason.
